# Acoustics Toolbox fixtures

The legacy input files directly in this directory are unmodified copies from the official Acoustics Toolbox `v2023.5` test suite. Derived numerical fixtures and their provenance are documented under [`golden/`](golden/README.md).

- Upstream: <https://github.com/oalib-acoustics/Acoustics-Toolbox>
- Commit: `475108519289c6fb488b58980c644ea14eccc604`
- Exact paths and SHA-256 values: [`manifest.toml`](manifest.toml)
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later; see the repository root `LICENSE`

They exercise legacy record syntax, representative two-dimensional environment options, range-dependent sound speed, boundary geometry, long boundary material records, and source beam patterns.
